q21598.en: The sign shown indicates a device to use when you need to ask for road assistance.

explain.short: SOS marks a call box: you use it to ask for road help.
explain.rule: Red square with 'SOS' = a call box to ask for road assistance (soccorso stradale). It is placed on the call box itself.
explain.trap: 'richiesta di soccorso stradale' (asking for road help) is exactly what SOS is for.

sceneParams.caption: SOS: call box for road assistance

q21599.en: The sign shown is placed on a call device for road assistance.

explain.short: The SOS sign is fixed on the call box itself, so you can find it quickly.
explain.rule: Red square with 'SOS' = a call box to ask for road assistance (soccorso stradale). It is placed on the call box itself.
explain.trap: 'è posto su' (is placed on) is right: the sign sits on the call device.

sceneParams.caption: SOS sign sits on the call box

q21600.en: The sign shown indicates an apparatus to call road assistance.

explain.short: SOS = a box you use to call road assistance in an emergency.
explain.rule: Red square with 'SOS' = a call box to ask for road assistance (soccorso stradale). It is placed on the call box itself.
explain.trap: 'apparecchio' (apparatus) is just another word for the call device.

sceneParams.caption: SOS: apparatus to call road help

q21601.en: The sign shown indicates a hospital zone.

explain.short: SOS marks a call box for road help, not a hospital. The hospital sign is a blue square with a white H.
explain.rule: Red square with 'SOS' = a call box to ask for road assistance (soccorso stradale). It is placed on the call box itself.
explain.trap: 'zona ospedaliera' (hospital zone) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: SOS = call box, not a hospital zone

q21602.en: The sign shown indicates a public telephone.

explain.short: SOS is only for calling road assistance, not an ordinary public phone.
explain.rule: Red square with 'SOS' = a call box to ask for road assistance (soccorso stradale). It is placed on the call box itself.
explain.trap: 'telefono pubblico' (public phone) has its own sign; SOS is only for road help.

sceneParams.caption: SOS = road help, not a public phone

q21603.en: The sign shown indicates a parking area for ambulances.

explain.short: SOS marks a call box for road help, not a place where ambulances stop.
explain.rule: Red square with 'SOS' = a call box to ask for road assistance (soccorso stradale). It is placed on the call box itself.
explain.trap: 'area di sosta per ambulanze' (ambulance parking) - nothing on the sign shows that.

sceneParams.caption: SOS = call box, not ambulance parking

q21604.en: The sign shown gives advance warning of a state secondary school.

explain.short: SOS has nothing to do with schools: it marks a call box for road help.
explain.rule: Red square with 'SOS' = a call box to ask for road assistance (soccorso stradale). It is placed on the call box itself.
explain.trap: 'scuola secondaria statale' (state secondary school) is pure invention.

sceneParams.caption: SOS = call box, not a school

q21605.en: The sign shown is placed at the start of a road with no way out for vehicles.

explain.short: The dead-end sign stands where the road begins, so you know before entering that you must come back.
explain.rule: Blue square, white T with a red top = dead-end road (strada senza uscita) for vehicles. It only informs; it bans nothing.
explain.trap: 'all'inizio' (at the start) is right: you see it before you enter.

sceneParams.caption: Dead end: placed at the start of the road

q21606.en: The sign shown also applies to motorcycles.

explain.short: A dead end has no way out for any vehicle, motorcycles included.
explain.rule: Blue square, white T with a red top = dead-end road (strada senza uscita) for vehicles. It only informs; it bans nothing.
explain.trap: 'anche' (also) is right: motorcycles are vehicles too.

sceneParams.caption: Dead end for motorcycles too

q21607.en: The sign shown indicates a road with no outlet for vehicles.

explain.short: The red bar on top of the T shows the road is closed at the end: vehicles cannot get out.
explain.rule: Blue square, white T with a red top = dead-end road (strada senza uscita) for vehicles. It only informs; it bans nothing.
explain.trap: 'senza sbocco' (no outlet) means the same as 'senza uscita' (no way out).

sceneParams.caption: Dead-end road: no outlet for vehicles

explain.short: It is an information sign: it only says the road has no way out. It bans nothing.
explain.rule: Blue square, white T with a red top = dead-end road (strada senza uscita) for vehicles. It only informs; it bans nothing.
explain.trap: 'vieta la sosta' (bans parking) - a blue square never bans; no parking is a round red-and-blue sign.

sceneParams.caption: Dead end only informs: no parking ban

q21609.en: The sign shown gives advance warning of a T-shaped junction.

explain.short: The T shows a dead end. A T-junction warning is a red triangle danger sign.
explain.rule: Blue square, white T with a red top = dead-end road (strada senza uscita) for vehicles. It only informs; it bans nothing.
explain.trap: 'incrocio a forma di T' (T-junction): the shape is a T, but the red top means a closed end.

sceneParams.caption: Not a T-junction: it is a dead end

q21610.en: The sign shown is placed near a tobacco shop.

explain.short: The white T is about the road, not about a tobacconist. It means dead end.
explain.rule: Blue square, white T with a red top = dead-end road (strada senza uscita) for vehicles. It only informs; it bans nothing.
explain.trap: 'tabaccheria' (tobacco shop) - the T of a tobacconist is not a road sign.

sceneParams.caption: T = dead end, not a tobacco shop

explain.short: The sign means dead end. Roadworks have a red triangle with a worker.
explain.rule: Blue square, white T with a red top = dead-end road (strada senza uscita) for vehicles. It only informs; it bans nothing.
explain.trap: 'lavori in corso' (roadworks) is a danger sign, not this blue one.

sceneParams.caption: Dead end, not roadworks

explain.short: It bans nothing. In a dead end you actually have to turn around to come back.
explain.rule: Blue square, white T with a red top = dead-end road (strada senza uscita) for vehicles. It only informs; it bans nothing.
explain.trap: 'vieta l'inversione di marcia' (bans U-turns) - the opposite is true: you must turn back.

sceneParams.caption: Dead end: no U-turn ban, you turn back

q21613.en: The sign shown also bans pedestrians from entering.

explain.short: It is not a ban, and the dead end is only for vehicles: pedestrians may often get through on foot.
explain.rule: Blue square, white T with a red top = dead-end road (strada senza uscita) for vehicles. It only informs; it bans nothing.
explain.trap: 'vieta di entrare anche ai pedoni' (bans pedestrians too) - it bans nobody.

sceneParams.caption: Dead end for vehicles; pedestrians not banned

q21614.en: The sign shown gives advance warning that the road on the right is a dead end for vehicles.

explain.short: The side branch on the right ends in red: that road has no way out for vehicles.
explain.rule: The red end on the right branch = the road on the right is a dead end for vehicles. Turning right and going straight are still allowed.
explain.trap: 'la strada di destra' (the road on the right) is right: the red end is on the right branch.

sceneParams.caption: Road on the right is a dead end

q21615.en: The sign shown allows turning right.

explain.short: It is only information: you may turn right, you just know the road there has no way out.
explain.rule: The red end on the right branch = the road on the right is a dead end for vehicles. Turning right and going straight are still allowed.
explain.trap: 'consente' (allows) is right: an information sign bans nothing.

sceneParams.caption: Right turn allowed: road is a dead end

q21616.en: The sign shown allows you to go straight on.

explain.short: The main road continues straight; only the side road on the right is closed.
explain.rule: The red end on the right branch = the road on the right is a dead end for vehicles. Turning right and going straight are still allowed.
explain.trap: 'proseguire diritto' (go straight on) is allowed: the straight road is open.

sceneParams.caption: Straight on is allowed

q21617.en: The sign shown also applies to motorcycles.

explain.short: The road on the right is a dead end for every vehicle, motorcycles included.
explain.rule: The red end on the right branch = the road on the right is a dead end for vehicles. Turning right and going straight are still allowed.
explain.trap: 'anche' (also) is right: motorcycles are vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: Dead end on the right: motorcycles too

q21618.en: The sign shown belongs to the information signs.

explain.short: A blue square that only tells you about the road is an information sign (segnale di indicazione).
explain.rule: The red end on the right branch = the road on the right is a dead end for vehicles. Turning right and going straight are still allowed.
explain.trap: 'segnali di indicazione' (information signs) is the right family: it informs, it does not order.

sceneParams.caption: An information sign

explain.short: It is an information sign: it bans nothing, U-turns included.
explain.rule: The red end on the right branch = the road on the right is a dead end for vehicles. Turning right and going straight are still allowed.
explain.trap: 'vieta' (bans) - information signs do not ban.

sceneParams.caption: No ban: it only warns of a dead end

q21620.en: The sign shown bans turning right.

explain.short: You may turn right: the sign only tells you that road has no way out.
explain.rule: The red end on the right branch = the road on the right is a dead end for vehicles. Turning right and going straight are still allowed.
explain.trap: 'vieta la svolta a destra' (bans right turn) is a round red sign, not this one.

sceneParams.caption: Right turn allowed: only a dead end

q21621.en: The sign shown indicates a lay-by on the right.

explain.short: The red end shows a closed road, not a lay-by for stopping.
explain.rule: The red end on the right branch = the road on the right is a dead end for vehicles. Turning right and going straight are still allowed.
explain.trap: 'piazzola di sosta' (lay-by) has its own sign with a P.

sceneParams.caption: Dead end on the right, not a lay-by

q21622.en: The sign shown gives advance warning of a car park on the right.

explain.short: A car park sign has a white P on blue. This one shows a dead-end road on the right.
explain.rule: The red end on the right branch = the road on the right is a dead end for vehicles. Turning right and going straight are still allowed.
explain.trap: 'area di parcheggio' (car park) - there is no P on this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Dead end on the right, not a car park

q21623.en: The sign shown also applies to pedestrians.

explain.short: The road on the right is a dead end for vehicles; pedestrians may often get through on foot.
explain.rule: The red end on the right branch = the road on the right is a dead end for vehicles. Turning right and going straight are still allowed.
explain.trap: 'anche per i pedoni' (pedestrians too) - the sign is about vehicles only.

sceneParams.caption: Dead end for vehicles, not pedestrians

q21624.en: The sign shown indicates the speed you are advised not to exceed in ideal traffic conditions.

explain.short: A blue square with a number is an advised speed: good advice, not a legal limit.
explain.rule: Blue square with a number = advised speed (velocità consigliata). It is advice only; the legal limit of the road still applies.
explain.trap: 'si consiglia' (it is advised) is the key: advice, not an order.

sceneParams.caption: Advised speed: better not go over 60

q21625.en: The sign shown allows you to travel at 50 km/h.

explain.short: 50 is below the advised 60, so it is fine. Nothing forces you to go faster.
explain.rule: Blue square with a number = advised speed (velocità consigliata). It is advice only; the legal limit of the road still applies.
explain.trap: 'consente' (allows) - going slower than the advised speed is always allowed.

sceneParams.caption: 50 km/h is fine: below the advised 60

q21626.en: The sign shown can be combined with a panel showing the length of the stretch of road where you are advised not to exceed the speed shown.

explain.short: A panel under the sign can tell you how long the stretch with the advised speed is.
explain.rule: Blue square with a number = advised speed (velocità consigliata). It is advice only; the legal limit of the road still applies.
explain.trap: 'può essere abbinato' (can be combined) is right: a length panel is allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Panel can show length of the stretch

q21627.en: The sign shown, if crossed by a red stripe, indicates the end of its validity.

explain.short: With a red diagonal bar, the same sign tells you the advised speed is over.
explain.rule: Blue square with a number = advised speed (velocità consigliata). It is advice only; the legal limit of the road still applies.
explain.trap: 'barrato da una striscia rossa' (crossed by a red stripe) = end of the advice.

sceneParams.caption: Red bar = end of advised speed

q21628.en: The sign shown allows you, on roads outside towns, to travel at 70 km/h.

explain.short: It is only advice. Outside towns the legal limit is 90 km/h, so 70 is allowed (keep it safe).
explain.rule: Blue square with a number = advised speed (velocità consigliata). It is advice only; the legal limit of the road still applies.
explain.trap: 'consente' (allows) - an advised speed is not a limit, so going a bit faster is not illegal.

sceneParams.caption: Advice only: 70 km/h legal outside towns

q21629.en: The sign shown bans vehicles weighing more than 60 tonnes fully loaded.

explain.short: The number is an advised speed in km/h, not a weight. Weight bans are round red signs with 't'.
explain.rule: Blue square with a number = advised speed (velocità consigliata). It is advice only; the legal limit of the road still applies.
explain.trap: '60 tonnellate' (60 tonnes) - there is no 't' and the sign is blue, not red.

sceneParams.caption: 60 = advised km/h, not tonnes

q21630.en: The sign shown indicates a minimum speed limit.

explain.short: A minimum speed is a ROUND blue sign. This SQUARE blue sign is only an advised speed.
explain.rule: Blue square with a number = advised speed (velocità consigliata). It is advice only; the legal limit of the road still applies.
explain.trap: 'limite minimo' (minimum limit) - square = advice, round = order.

sceneParams.caption: Advised speed, not a minimum speed

q21631.en: The sign shown bans exceeding the speed shown.

explain.short: It does not ban anything: it only advises. A speed ban is a round sign with a red border.
explain.rule: Blue square with a number = advised speed (velocità consigliata). It is advice only; the legal limit of the road still applies.
explain.trap: 'vieta' (bans) - an advised speed never bans.

sceneParams.caption: Advice only: no ban on going faster

q21632.en: The sign shown indicates the safety distance to keep from the vehicle in front.

explain.short: The number is a speed in km/h, not a distance in metres.
explain.rule: Blue square with a number = advised speed (velocità consigliata). It is advice only; the legal limit of the road still applies.
explain.trap: 'distanza di sicurezza' (safety distance) - the sign shows an advised speed.

sceneParams.caption: Advised speed, not safety distance

q21633.en: The sign shown indicates that you may not travel at a speed lower than the one shown.

explain.short: You may always go slower than an advised speed. A minimum speed is a round blue sign.
explain.rule: Blue square with a number = advised speed (velocità consigliata). It is advice only; the legal limit of the road still applies.
explain.trap: 'non è possibile viaggiare ad una velocità più bassa' (cannot go slower) describes a minimum speed.

sceneParams.caption: Going slower is allowed

q21634.en: The sign shown indicates the kilometres already travelled from the starting point of the road.

explain.short: Kilometre markers (cippi chilometrici) look different. This blue square is an advised speed.
explain.rule: Blue square with a number = advised speed (velocità consigliata). It is advice only; the legal limit of the road still applies.
explain.trap: 'chilometri già fatti' (kilometres travelled) - the number is km/h, not km.

sceneParams.caption: Advised speed, not a kilometre marker

q21635.en: The sign shown indicates a road reserved for motor vehicles only.

explain.short: The white car on blue marks a road where only vehicles with an engine may drive.
explain.rule: Blue square with a white car = road for motor vehicles only. No bicycles or other vehicles without an engine.
explain.trap: 'soli veicoli a motore' (motor vehicles only) is exactly the meaning.

sceneParams.caption: Road for motor vehicles only

explain.short: A bicycle has no engine, so it may not use a road for motor vehicles only.
explain.rule: Blue square with a white car = road for motor vehicles only. No bicycles or other vehicles without an engine.
explain.trap: 'vieta' (bans) - here it is right: bikes are not motor vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: No bicycles: motor vehicles only

q21637.en: The sign shown is placed at the start of a road reserved for motor vehicles.

explain.short: You see it where the road for motor vehicles begins.
explain.rule: Blue square with a white car = road for motor vehicles only. No bicycles or other vehicles without an engine.
explain.trap: 'all'inizio' (at the start) is right; with a red bar it marks the end.

sceneParams.caption: Placed at the start of the road

q21638.en: The sign shown bans vehicles without an engine.

explain.short: Only motor vehicles may use this road, so all vehicles without an engine are banned.
explain.rule: Blue square with a white car = road for motor vehicles only. No bicycles or other vehicles without an engine.
explain.trap: 'senza motore' (without an engine) - bikes, carts and similar may not enter.

sceneParams.caption: No vehicles without an engine

q21639.en: The sign shown allows buses through.

explain.short: A bus has an engine, so it may use the road.
explain.rule: Blue square with a white car = road for motor vehicles only. No bicycles or other vehicles without an engine.
explain.trap: 'consente' (allows) is right: buses are motor vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: Buses allowed: they are motor vehicles

q21640.en: The sign shown, if crossed by a red stripe, indicates the end of its validity.

explain.short: With a red diagonal bar it marks the end of the road for motor vehicles only.
explain.rule: Blue square with a white car = road for motor vehicles only. No bicycles or other vehicles without an engine.
explain.trap: 'barrato da una striscia rossa' (crossed by a red stripe) = end.

sceneParams.caption: Red bar = end of the motor-vehicle road

q21641.en: The sign shown indicates a road reserved for taxis only.

explain.short: It is for all motor vehicles, not only taxis.
explain.rule: Blue square with a white car = road for motor vehicles only. No bicycles or other vehicles without an engine.
explain.trap: 'solo ai taxi' (only taxis) is too narrow: every motor vehicle may use it.

sceneParams.caption: All motor vehicles, not only taxis

q21642.en: The sign shown indicates a car park for cars only.

explain.short: There is no P: it marks a road for motor vehicles, not a car park.
explain.rule: Blue square with a white car = road for motor vehicles only. No bicycles or other vehicles without an engine.
explain.trap: 'parcheggio' (car park) - a car park sign has a white P.

sceneParams.caption: A road, not a car park

q21643.en: The sign shown allows a bicycle to use that road.

explain.short: Bicycles have no engine, so they are banned from this road.
explain.rule: Blue square with a white car = road for motor vehicles only. No bicycles or other vehicles without an engine.
explain.trap: 'consente ad una bicicletta' (allows a bicycle) - the opposite is true.

sceneParams.caption: Bicycles are banned here

explain.short: A lorry (autocarro) has an engine, so it may use the road.
explain.rule: Blue square with a white car = road for motor vehicles only. No bicycles or other vehicles without an engine.
explain.trap: 'autocarro' (lorry) is a motor vehicle, so it is allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Lorries allowed: they are motor vehicles

q21645.en: The sign shown is placed at the start of a tunnel.

explain.short: The tunnel sign stands at the tunnel entrance.
explain.rule: Green square with a tunnel = motorway tunnel (galleria). No stopping inside; engine off in long stops; hold the wheel at the exit.
explain.trap: 'all'inizio di una galleria' (at the start of a tunnel) is right.

sceneParams.caption: Tunnel sign at the entrance

q21646.en: The sign shown gives advance warning of a motorway tunnel.

explain.short: Green background = motorway, and the picture shows a tunnel opening.
explain.rule: Green square with a tunnel = motorway tunnel (galleria). No stopping inside; engine off in long stops; hold the wheel at the exit.
explain.trap: 'autostradale' (motorway) comes from the green colour.

sceneParams.caption: Green = motorway tunnel

q21647.en: The sign shown reminds you to switch off the engine in case of a long stop in the tunnel.

explain.short: In a tunnel exhaust fumes build up, so if you are stuck for long you switch the engine off.
explain.rule: Green square with a tunnel = motorway tunnel (galleria). No stopping inside; engine off in long stops; hold the wheel at the exit.
explain.trap: 'arresto prolungato' (long stop) is the case: engine off.

sceneParams.caption: Long stop in a tunnel: engine off

q21648.en: The sign shown reminds you not to park or stop in the tunnel, unless signs say otherwise.

explain.short: Stopping in a tunnel is dangerous, so it is not allowed unless signs say so.
explain.rule: Green square with a tunnel = motorway tunnel (galleria). No stopping inside; engine off in long stops; hold the wheel at the exit.
explain.trap: 'salvo diversa segnalazione' (unless signs say otherwise) keeps the statement correct.

sceneParams.caption: No parking or stopping in a tunnel

q21649.en: The sign shown invites you to hold the steering wheel firmly to deal with possible gusts of wind at the tunnel exit.

explain.short: When you leave a tunnel a sudden side wind can push the car, so hold the wheel firmly.
explain.rule: Green square with a tunnel = motorway tunnel (galleria). No stopping inside; engine off in long stops; hold the wheel at the exit.
explain.trap: 'all'uscita della galleria' (at the tunnel exit) is where the wind hits you.

sceneParams.caption: Tunnel exit: hold the wheel against wind

q21650.en: The sign shown indicates a closed road.

explain.short: It shows a tunnel you can drive through, not a closed road.
explain.rule: Green square with a tunnel = motorway tunnel (galleria). No stopping inside; engine off in long stops; hold the wheel at the exit.
explain.trap: 'strada chiusa' (closed road) - the tunnel opening is open.

sceneParams.caption: A tunnel, not a closed road

explain.short: It shows a tunnel. Roadworks have a red triangle with a worker.
explain.rule: Green square with a tunnel = motorway tunnel (galleria). No stopping inside; engine off in long stops; hold the wheel at the exit.
explain.trap: 'lavori in corso' (roadworks) is a danger sign, not this green one.

sceneParams.caption: A tunnel, not roadworks

q21652.en: The sign shown indicates an unlit tunnel.

explain.short: The sign just says 'tunnel'; it says nothing about the lights inside.
explain.rule: Green square with a tunnel = motorway tunnel (galleria). No stopping inside; engine off in long stops; hold the wheel at the exit.
explain.trap: 'non illuminata' (unlit) - the black inside is only the drawing of the opening.

sceneParams.caption: Tunnel sign says nothing about lights

q21653.en: The sign shown bans vehicles taller than 3.5 metres.

explain.short: There is no number on it: it is a tunnel information sign. Height limits are round red signs.
explain.rule: Green square with a tunnel = motorway tunnel (galleria). No stopping inside; engine off in long stops; hold the wheel at the exit.
explain.trap: '3,5 metri di altezza' (3.5 m height) - no height is shown.

sceneParams.caption: Tunnel info, not a height limit

q21654.en: The sign shown indicates the start of a bridge.

explain.short: The picture is a tunnel opening. The bridge sign shows a road on top of an arch.
explain.rule: Green square with a tunnel = motorway tunnel (galleria). No stopping inside; engine off in long stops; hold the wheel at the exit.
explain.trap: 'ponte' (bridge) is a different green sign.

sceneParams.caption: A tunnel, not a bridge

explain.short: It is an information sign about a tunnel; it bans nothing.
explain.rule: Green square with a tunnel = motorway tunnel (galleria). No stopping inside; engine off in long stops; hold the wheel at the exit.
explain.trap: 'vieta il sorpasso' (bans overtaking) is a round red sign with two cars.

sceneParams.caption: Tunnel info: no overtaking ban

q21656.en: The sign shown can be found at the start of a bridge, a viaduct or an overpass.

explain.short: The picture is a road on an arch: a bridge, viaduct or overpass starts here.
explain.rule: Green square with a bridge = start of a bridge, viaduct or overpass. Watch out for side wind.
explain.trap: 'ponte, viadotto, cavalcavia' (bridge, viaduct, overpass) are all roads over something.

sceneParams.caption: Start of a bridge, viaduct or overpass

q21657.en: The sign shown can be combined with a panel showing the length of the overpass.

explain.short: A panel under the sign can tell you how long the overpass is.
explain.rule: Green square with a bridge = start of a bridge, viaduct or overpass. Watch out for side wind.
explain.trap: 'può essere abbinato' (can be combined) is right: a length panel is allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Panel can show the length

q21658.en: The sign shown invites you to take special care in strong wind.

explain.short: On a bridge there is no shelter, so strong wind hits the car hard.
explain.rule: Green square with a bridge = start of a bridge, viaduct or overpass. Watch out for side wind.
explain.trap: 'forte vento' (strong wind) is a real danger on bridges.

sceneParams.caption: On a bridge, watch out for strong wind

q21659.en: The sign shown invites you to hold the steering wheel firmly to deal with possible gusts of side wind.

explain.short: Side wind on a bridge can push you sideways, so hold the wheel firmly.
explain.rule: Green square with a bridge = start of a bridge, viaduct or overpass. Watch out for side wind.
explain.trap: 'vento laterale' (side wind) is the danger on an open bridge.

sceneParams.caption: Hold the wheel against side wind

q21660.en: The sign shown orders a ban on overtaking between motor vehicles.

explain.short: It is an information sign about a bridge; it orders nothing.
explain.rule: Green square with a bridge = start of a bridge, viaduct or overpass. Watch out for side wind.
explain.trap: 'prescrive il divieto di sorpasso' (orders no overtaking) is a round red sign.

sceneParams.caption: Bridge info: no overtaking ban

q21661.en: The sign shown indicates the start of a tunnel.

explain.short: The picture is a road on an arch (bridge). The tunnel sign shows a dark opening.
explain.rule: Green square with a bridge = start of a bridge, viaduct or overpass. Watch out for side wind.
explain.trap: 'galleria' (tunnel) is a different green sign.

sceneParams.caption: A bridge, not a tunnel

q21662.en: The sign shown indicates that you are about to pass under a bridge.

explain.short: You drive ON the bridge (the white road on top), not under it.
explain.rule: Green square with a bridge = start of a bridge, viaduct or overpass. Watch out for side wind.
explain.trap: 'sotto un ponte' (under a bridge) - the road is drawn on top of the arch.

sceneParams.caption: You go ON the bridge, not under it

q21663.en: The sign shown indicates a cycle crossing.

explain.short: The white cyclist on a blue square marks a place where bikes cross the road.
explain.rule: Blue square with a cyclist = cycle crossing (attraversamento ciclabile). Give way to cyclists crossing on the stripes.
explain.trap: 'attraversamento ciclabile' (cycle crossing) is exactly the meaning.

sceneParams.caption: Cycle crossing: bikes cross here

q21664.en: The sign shown is placed right at the stripes of the cycle crossing.

explain.short: The sign stands exactly where the crossing stripes are painted.
explain.rule: Blue square with a cyclist = cycle crossing (attraversamento ciclabile). Give way to cyclists crossing on the stripes.
explain.trap: 'in corrispondenza' (right at) is right: at the stripes.

sceneParams.caption: Placed right at the crossing stripes

q21665.en: The sign shown indicates that you must give way to cyclists crossing on the stripes.

explain.short: Cyclists on the crossing stripes go first: you slow down and let them cross.
explain.rule: Blue square with a cyclist = cycle crossing (attraversamento ciclabile). Give way to cyclists crossing on the stripes.
explain.trap: 'dare la precedenza ai ciclisti' (give way to cyclists) is right, when they are on the stripes.

sceneParams.caption: Give way to cyclists on the stripes

q21666.en: The sign shown goes together with the cycle crossing stripes.

explain.short: The sign and the painted stripes work together to mark the cycle crossing.
explain.rule: Blue square with a cyclist = cycle crossing (attraversamento ciclabile). Give way to cyclists crossing on the stripes.
explain.trap: 'abbinato' (combined with) is right: sign plus stripes.

sceneParams.caption: Sign + stripes = cycle crossing

q21667.en: The sign shown invites caution because we may find cyclists crossing the carriageway.

explain.short: Cyclists may cross here, so slow down and look out for them.
explain.rule: Blue square with a cyclist = cycle crossing (attraversamento ciclabile). Give way to cyclists crossing on the stripes.
explain.trap: 'usare prudenza' (be careful) is right: bikes may appear.

sceneParams.caption: Be careful: cyclists may cross

q21668.en: The sign shown bans vehicles without an engine.

explain.short: It does not ban anyone: it shows where bikes cross. The car on blue is the 'motor vehicles only' sign.
explain.rule: Blue square with a cyclist = cycle crossing (attraversamento ciclabile). Give way to cyclists crossing on the stripes.
explain.trap: 'vieta il transito' (bans transit) - this sign bans nothing.

sceneParams.caption: Cycle crossing: no ban

explain.short: The opposite: it shows a place where cyclists cross. A ban on bikes is a round red sign.
explain.rule: Blue square with a cyclist = cycle crossing (attraversamento ciclabile). Give way to cyclists crossing on the stripes.
explain.trap: 'vieta il transito ai ciclisti' (bans cyclists) - square blue never bans.

sceneParams.caption: Cyclists are not banned: they cross here

q21670.en: The sign shown indicates a cycle path.

explain.short: A cycle path (pista ciclabile) is a ROUND blue sign. This square one is a cycle crossing.
explain.rule: Blue square with a cyclist = cycle crossing (attraversamento ciclabile). Give way to cyclists crossing on the stripes.
explain.trap: 'pista ciclabile' (cycle path) - round = path, square = crossing.

sceneParams.caption: Cycle crossing, not a cycle path

q21671.en: The sign shown tells cyclists to turn left.

explain.short: It gives no direction to cyclists: it only marks a cycle crossing.
explain.rule: Blue square with a cyclist = cycle crossing (attraversamento ciclabile). Give way to cyclists crossing on the stripes.
explain.trap: 'svoltare a sinistra' (turn left) - there is no arrow on the sign.

sceneParams.caption: No direction: only a cycle crossing

q21672.en: The sign shown obliges cyclists to give way to vehicles.

explain.short: It is the other way round: drivers give way to cyclists on the crossing stripes.
explain.rule: Blue square with a cyclist = cycle crossing (attraversamento ciclabile). Give way to cyclists crossing on the stripes.
explain.trap: 'obbliga i ciclisti a dare la precedenza' (cyclists must give way) - the opposite is true.

sceneParams.caption: Drivers give way to cyclists, not reverse
